title: Network Exfiltration Flow
description: Visualize lateral movement and external data transfer (Sankey Diagram)
sql: SELECT source_ip, dest_ip, sum(bytes) as flow_bytes FROM unified_timeline WHERE action='NETWORK_FLOW' GROUP BY source_ip, dest_ip HAVING flow_bytes > 1000
